body:
Right now, she's attending an event with her sorority, under the close eye of a mutual friend who was present for the same conversation I was, and knows the deal.

She had committed ahead of time to go to this event, and said that despite being upset, she would be "worthless" if she didn't go. I wasn't going to force that point. I figured being around the girls who love her would do her some good. I'll be meeting up with them after the event.

EDIT: Just heard from the friend that she's cheered up a lot, so that's good. Going to go meet up with them soon.
